intro.en: Open one to look. On the page, the comma and full stop keys (, .) move to the previous or next version, N opens your notes, M marks a spot, B comes back here. Scores here or there.
intro.zh: 打開一版來看。在頁面上，逗號和句號鍵（, .）換到上一版或下一版，N 打開筆記，M 標記一個地方，B 回到這裡。分數在這裡或頁面上都可以打。

title.en: Where I have been, round two

title.zh: 慢慢累積：國家、航程、照片

title.en: Your trips as one camera move
One stamp at a time, eleven ways with Impeccable
title.zh: 一次一個章，用 Impeccable 做的十一種
高級感：六個安靜的版本

title.en: High-end: the three you liked, mixed
title.zh: 高級感：你喜歡的三版，兩兩混合

desc.en: The Journey tab as it is now. Since 9 November the first screen is your footprint map (One breath out, slower still, which you gave 5): it zooms out from Taiwan while your countries colour in and the three numbers count up. On the first scroll the names and numbers lift away and the map itself curls into the globe, uncovering your newest trip's photograph under a light paper veil (Off a photograph, your pick of round nine), smoothed so it follows your scroll like a weighted sheet and never stalls; the trips on one line. The main one.
desc.zh: 現在的旅程頁。11/9 起，一打開是你的足跡地圖（你給 5 分的「一口氣拉遠，再慢一點」）：從台灣拉遠，去過的國家一個個上色，三個數字往上跳。一往下捲，國名和數字淡掉，地圖本身捲成地球，底下露出你最近一趟旅行的照片，蓋一層淡淡的紙（第九輪你選的「掀開露出照片」），而且調順了：跟著你的捲動像一張有重量的紙，不會卡。所有旅程掛在一條線上。這是主要版本。

desc.en: A4: the flat map closes into a large globe on the whole screen, home sends out a ring, the panel slides in. A pale blue chart surface.
desc.zh: A4：平面地圖在整個畫面上合成大地球，台灣亮一圈，面板滑進來。表面是淡藍色海圖。

desc.en: New: the live page's quiet paper globe, with A4's movement and the whole page wrapping up into it, so no rectangle lifts off the background. The smallest step from what is live.
desc.zh: 新的：正式版安靜的紙質地球，加上 A4 的動態，而且是整個頁面包成地球，不會有一塊長方形從背景翹起來。和正式版差最少的一步。

title.en: The map to the edges, numbers along the foot
title.zh: 滿版地圖＋底部三個數字

desc.en: The map fills the whole window with no white margin; the three numbers sit in one row in the southern sea along the bottom. No stamp.
desc.zh: 地圖填滿整個視窗，沒有白邊；三個數字在下面的南方海上排成一排。沒有印章。

title.zh: 從家出發，視野越來越大

desc.en: It opens close in on Taiwan; with each trip the map slowly widens to take in the new places, until the whole world fills the window. The numbers stay put in one corner.
desc.zh: 一開始只看到台灣附近；每一趟旅行，地圖慢慢拉遠，把新去的地方包進來，最後整個世界填滿視窗。數字固定在一角。

title.en: From home, ending on the wall map

desc.en: The two you liked joined: it opens close on Taiwan and widens trip by trip, ending on the full wall map with the three numbers along the foot.
desc.zh: 你喜歡的兩張合在一起：一開始只看到台灣附近，一趟一趟拉遠，最後停在滿版地圖，三個數字在最下面。

desc.en: The wall map with the world's mountains printed softly under the colours, so the Alps, the Himalaya and New Zealand show through.
desc.zh: 滿版地圖底下淡淡印上全世界的地形，阿爾卑斯山、喜馬拉雅山、紐西蘭的山都看得到。

desc.en: The wall map with a taller band along the foot and the three numbers as large as it allows, engraved on the sea.
desc.zh: 滿版地圖，下面的海變高，三個數字放到最大，像刻在海圖上。

desc.en: The wall map with a small ink point for each of the 62 places you went, appearing trip by trip; point at one for its name.
desc.zh: 滿版地圖，你去過的 62 個地方各一個小墨點，一趟一趟出現；指著它會顯示地名。

title.en: Trip by trip, the view follows

desc.en: It opens close on Taiwan and frames each trip in turn, close for Japan, wide for Europe, then pulls back to the whole world. Click to skip to the end.
desc.zh: 一開始只看到台灣附近，接著每一趟都把畫面移到那趟去的地方，去日本就拉近，去歐洲就拉遠，最後看到整個世界。點一下可以直接跳到最後。

title.zh: 同樣的節奏，快一倍以上

desc.en: Your pick with the same moves, compressed: it rests in about four seconds instead of ten. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 你挑的那張，動作一樣，壓縮成大約 4 秒（原本約 10 秒）。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

desc.en: Nine beats, one per year you travelled, instead of sixteen trips: about three seconds. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 照年份走，九個節拍（原本十六趟）：大約 3 秒。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

desc.en: No steps: the view widens from Taiwan to the whole world in one smooth move while the colours and numbers fill in, about three seconds. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 沒有分段：畫面一口氣從台灣拉遠到全世界，顏色和數字同時填滿，大約 3 秒。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

desc.en: The three numbers arrive in about a second; the map widens and colours just behind them, resting at about three seconds. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 三個數字大約 1 秒就到位，地圖跟在後面拉遠、上色，大約 3 秒停下。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

title.en: A glimpse of what is below

desc.en: The faster tempo, and the top of your trip list peeks in under the numbers, so the eye goes down by itself. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 快一點的節奏，加上數字下面露出一點旅行清單的開頭，讓人自然往下看。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

title.en: One breath out, a little slower

desc.en: One breath out at about one and a half times the time: it rests at about 4.7 seconds instead of 3. The names on the map are lettered as in round five again (the year under the large names, fine leaders to the small ones), and the whole map shows top to bottom with the numbers lying over its foot. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 一口氣拉遠，時間拉長約一倍半：大約 4.7 秒停下（原本約 3 秒）。地圖上的國名換回第五輪的字樣（大國的年份放在名字下面，小國用細線拉出來），地圖從上到下整張露出來，數字直接壓在地圖下方。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

desc.en: The same, a little slower again: it rests at about 6 seconds. The names on the map are lettered as in round five again (the year under the large names, fine leaders to the small ones), and the whole map shows top to bottom with the numbers lying over its foot. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 一樣的做法，再慢一點：大約 6 秒停下。地圖上的國名換回第五輪的字樣（大國的年份放在名字下面，小國用細線拉出來），地圖從上到下整張露出來，數字直接壓在地圖下方。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

title.en: The whole map, no zoom, a little slower
title.zh: 整張地圖不拉遠，慢一點

desc.en: No zoom: the whole wall map is there from the first moment, uncoloured, and stays still; only your countries colour in, the flights draw and the numbers climb, in the order you went. Rests at about 4.7 seconds, the same tempo as 2. Scrolling, a tap or a key jumps straight to the end.
desc.zh: 不拉遠：一開始就是整張地圖，還沒有顏色，畫面完全不動；只有你去過的國家照順序上色、航線畫出來、數字往上跳。大約 4.7 秒停下，跟第 2 張一樣快。一捲動、點一下或按鍵，就直接跳到最後。

desc.en: The whole map curls round into the globe as one sheet of paper, Taiwan first. The globe is now painted like your footprint map (the same paper, sea lines and country colours) and lies exactly under it, so as you start to scroll only the names and numbers fade away and the map itself folds. Scroll slowly to watch it.
desc.zh: 整張地圖像一張紙一樣捲成地球，台灣先開始。地球現在畫得跟你的足跡地圖一樣（同樣的紙、海上的細線、國家的顏色），而且剛好疊在它正下方，所以一開始往下捲，只有國名和數字淡掉，地圖本身直接捲成地球。慢慢往下捲比較看得清楚。

desc.en: The map parts into small square prints that are laid on the ball one by one, Taiwan's first, as the live page does now. The globe is now painted like your footprint map (the same paper, sea lines and country colours) and lies exactly under it, so as you start to scroll only the names and numbers fade away and the map itself folds. Scroll slowly to watch it.
desc.zh: 地圖分成一張張小方塊，從台灣開始一張張貼到球上，跟現在正式版的動法一樣。地球現在畫得跟你的足跡地圖一樣（同樣的紙、海上的細線、國家的顏色），而且剛好疊在它正下方，所以一開始往下捲，只有國名和數字淡掉，地圖本身直接捲成地球。慢慢往下捲比較看得清楚。

desc.en: The map curls away into the globe and uncovers your newest trip's photograph underneath, under a light paper veil. The globe is now painted like your footprint map (the same paper, sea lines and country colours) and lies exactly under it, so as you start to scroll only the names and numbers fade away and the map itself folds. Scroll slowly to watch it. Your pick: since 9 November it is the live page (number 1), smoothed.
desc.zh: 地圖捲成地球的時候，底下露出你最近一趟旅行的照片，上面蓋一層淡淡的紙。地球現在畫得跟你的足跡地圖一樣（同樣的紙、海上的細線、國家的顏色），而且剛好疊在它正下方，所以一開始往下捲，只有國名和數字淡掉，地圖本身直接捲成地球。慢慢往下捲比較看得清楚。你選了這張：11/9 起是正式版（第 1 張），而且調順了。

desc.en: The whole globe stays in view and turns with your scroll from trip to trip, instead of turning on its own when a new trip comes up. After the fold, your trips are the chapters of one camera move that your scroll conducts: the globe holds on a trip while you read it and travels in the last part of the way to the next, the same at the same place every time, forward or back. A long passage rises higher on the way, as a flight does. Built with the scroll-world skill; the start is the live page as it is. On a phone it stays as the live page.
desc.zh: 整顆地球都在畫面裡，跟著你的捲動從一趟轉到下一趟，而不是換到新的一趟才自己轉過去。地圖捲成地球之後，你的每一趟旅程是一段鏡頭的一章，由你的捲動帶著走：讀某一趟時地球停在那裡，捲到下一趟的最後一段才移過去；同一個位置每次都一樣，往上往下都可以。距離遠的（例如緬甸到美國）中途會升高一點，像飛機一樣。用 scroll-world 這個 skill 做的；開頭和正式版一樣，手機上也維持正式版。

desc.en: The camera comes in low over the globe, so each trip's countries fill the space beside the list, and glides on to the next. After the fold, your trips are the chapters of one camera move that your scroll conducts: the globe holds on a trip while you read it and travels in the last part of the way to the next, the same at the same place every time, forward or back. A long passage rises higher on the way, as a flight does. Built with the scroll-world skill; the start is the live page as it is. On a phone it stays as the live page.
desc.zh: 鏡頭貼近地球，讓每一趟去的國家佔滿清單旁邊的空間，再滑到下一趟。地圖捲成地球之後，你的每一趟旅程是一段鏡頭的一章，由你的捲動帶著走：讀某一趟時地球停在那裡，捲到下一趟的最後一段才移過去；同一個位置每次都一樣，往上往下都可以。距離遠的（例如緬甸到美國）中途會升高一點，像飛機一樣。用 scroll-world 這個 skill 做的；開頭和正式版一樣，手機上也維持正式版。

desc.en: The camera comes down near the globe, so its curve becomes a horizon low on the screen with your photograph as the sky above, and each trip's countries rise up over the curve. After the fold, your trips are the chapters of one camera move that your scroll conducts: the globe holds on a trip while you read it and travels in the last part of the way to the next, the same at the same place every time, forward or back. A long passage rises higher on the way, as a flight does. Built with the scroll-world skill; the start is the live page as it is. On a phone it stays as the live page.
desc.zh: 鏡頭降到地球旁邊，地球的弧線變成畫面下方的地平線，上面是你的照片當天空，每一趟去的國家從弧線上升起來。地圖捲成地球之後，你的每一趟旅程是一段鏡頭的一章，由你的捲動帶著走：讀某一趟時地球停在那裡，捲到下一趟的最後一段才移過去；同一個位置每次都一樣，往上往下都可以。距離遠的（例如緬甸到美國）中途會升高一點，像飛機一樣。用 scroll-world 這個 skill 做的；開頭和正式版一樣，手機上也維持正式版。

desc.en: The scratch map, with the count much bigger and the share of the world (10.3% of 195 countries). The stamps sit on a passport page beside the map, never on the countries; point at one to light its country.
desc.zh: 刮刮地圖，國家數字更大，加上去過全世界幾 %（195 國的 10.3%）。印章蓋在地圖旁邊的護照內頁上，不壓在國家上；指著印章，它的國家會亮起來。

title.en: Hand-tinted atlas, stamps round the edge

desc.en: The hand-tinted atlas, the count large in its cartouche with the share of the world. The stamps make a border round the sheet, each on the side nearest its country, a fine line leading to it.
desc.zh: 手工上色的老地圖，大數字放在標題框裡，加上全世界的百分比。印章排成地圖四周的邊框，各自靠近自己國家那一邊，用細線連過去。

title.en: Scratch map, stamps year by year
title.zh: 刮刮地圖＋印章一年一年排

desc.en: The scratch map with the count large, the share of the world in words and as 195 small squares, 20 of them scratched gold. The stamps run along the bottom in a row, under their years.
desc.zh: 刮刮地圖，大數字，全世界的百分比用字寫，也用 195 個小方格表示，刮開 20 格。印章在下面排成一排，照年份放。

title.en: Hand-tinted atlas, one stamp at a time

desc.en: The hand-tinted atlas with the count large in one corner and the share of the world. One stamp in the other corner: it presses through your countries once in order, then shows the one you point at, so stamps never pile up.
desc.zh: 手工上色的老地圖，一角放大數字和全世界的百分比。另一角只放一個印章：一開始照順序蓋過每個國家一次，之後指到哪個國家就換成哪個章，所以不會疊在一起。

desc.en: Impeccable "bolder": the count, the washes and the stamp at full strength. Reviewers: 22 of 32, better than the one you liked. The only version that makes the count clearly bigger, keeping the tinted atlas and one calm stamp.
desc.zh: Impeccable「bolder」：數字、水彩和印章都放到最強。評審：32 分拿 22 分，比你喜歡的原版好。唯一把數字明顯放大的版本，手繪上色地圖和一次一個章都還在。

title.en: Set like an atlas title page

desc.en: Impeccable "typeset": the count and labels set like the title page and lettering of a fine atlas. Reviewers: 25 of 32, about the same as the one you liked. The best-made lettering of the round, but the count is not bigger, and smaller on a phone.
desc.zh: Impeccable「typeset」：數字和地名照精緻地圖集的書名頁和字的層次來排。評審：32 分拿 25 分，跟你喜歡的原版差不多。這輪字體做得最好，但數字沒變大，手機上反而更小。

desc.en: Impeccable "colorize": a printed-atlas palette, one wash per continent, each stamp in its country's colour. Reviewers: 23 of 32, not as good as the one you liked. It adds a key, a blue sea and new hues to a page you wants calmer, and the count stays the same.
desc.zh: Impeccable「colorize」：印刷地圖集的配色，每個大洲一種水彩，印章用自己國家的顏色。評審：32 分拿 23 分，不如你喜歡的原版。多了圖例、淡藍的海和新的顏色，頁面變熱鬧，數字也沒有變大。

desc.en: Impeccable "animate": the engraving draws in, then each country's wash bleeds in as its stamp presses, in the order you went. Reviewers: 21 of 32, not as good as the one you liked. The engraving is lovely, but the map starts colourless and takes about twenty seconds to show your countries.
desc.zh: Impeccable「animate」：地圖的線先畫出來，然後照你去的順序，每個國家的水彩慢慢暈開，同時蓋上它的章。評審：32 分拿 21 分，不如你喜歡的原版。刻版的過程很美，但地圖一開始沒有顏色，要大約二十秒才看得到你去過的國家。

desc.en: Impeccable "delight": small atlas touches, such as a wash that lifts like paper and a pencilled note by the stamp. Reviewers: 22 of 32, about the same as the one you liked. Quiet, well-judged hand marks, but barely visible at a glance, and the count stays the same size.
desc.zh: Impeccable「delight」：一些小細節，像水彩像紙一樣微微浮起、印章旁邊鉛筆寫的小字。評審：32 分拿 22 分，跟你喜歡的原版差不多。手寫記號安靜又得體，但一眼幾乎看不出來，數字大小也沒變。

title.en: Only where I have been, hand-tinted
title.zh: 只有去過的地方，上色版

desc.en: Only your countries drawn, painted in watercolour like the atlas, the count as large as it will go with the share of the world beside it, and a row of small stamps under it.
desc.zh: 只畫你去過的國家，用老地圖的水彩上色，國家數字放到最大，旁邊寫全世界的百分比，下面一排小印章。

desc.en: The world under a thin foil, like the scratch-off poster. The countries you have been to are scratched clean, one by one in the order you went, showing the coloured map beneath. The corner box says how many of the world's 195 you have scratched.
desc.zh: 整個世界蓋在一層薄薄的金屬膜下，像刮刮地圖海報。你去過的國家照你去的先後一個一個刮開，露出底下彩色的地圖。角落的小框寫著全世界 195 個國家你刮開了幾個。

desc.en: An old engraved world map, every country in fine ink line only. The ones you have been to are coloured by hand in watercolour, laid one by one in the order you went, each with its name and the year. The counts sit in the title box.
desc.zh: 一張老式的雕版世界地圖，每個國家只有細細的墨線。你去過的國家用水彩一個一個手工上色，照你去的先後，旁邊寫著國名和年份。數字在標題框裡。

desc.en: Only the countries you have been to are drawn, solid, at their true places; the rest of the world is left out. They read like islands of your own world, with the number of countries set very large beside them.
desc.zh: 地圖上只畫你去過的國家，實心的，放在它們真正的位置；世界其他地方都不畫。看起來像一片屬於你自己的群島，旁邊用很大的字寫著去過幾個國家。

desc.en: A light printed map with an entry stamp pressed on every country you have been to: different stamp shapes and inks, each with the country, the date you first went and the airport you landed at. Taiwan gets a Home stamp; a big stamp in the corner holds the count.
desc.zh: 一張淡淡的地圖，你去過的每個國家都蓋上一個入境章：形狀和墨色都不一樣，上面有國名、第一次去的日期和降落的機場。台灣蓋的是「家」；角落一個大章寫著你去過幾個國家。

desc.en: A paper wall map with a pin pushed in at every place you have been, and a red thread running from the home pin in Taipei out along each trip and back. The counts are on a small card pinned in the corner.
desc.zh: 一張貼在牆上的紙地圖，你去過的每個地方都插了一根圖釘，一條紅線從台北的家出發，沿著每一趟旅行繞出去再回來。數字寫在角落一張釘著的小卡片上。

title.en: Unveil: the page lifts off a photograph
title.zh: 揭開：整頁地圖從照片上掀起

desc.en: Nothing comes apart: the map is the page itself, and it folds up into the globe in one slow movement, the scroll carrying more weight. Its edges thin away as it lifts, and beneath it lies the photograph of the trip, softened by a sheet of paper and settling as it is uncovered; it stays for the reading.
desc.zh: 什麼都不拆開：地圖就是這一頁本身，用一個慢慢的動作折成地球，捲動帶一點重量。掀起時四邊慢慢淡掉，底下是這趟旅程的照片，蓋著一層薄紙，掀開時慢慢沉穩下來，開始讀旅程時就留在背後。

title.en: The hang: eighteen prints, one wall
title.zh: 畫廊：十八張照片掛成一面牆

desc.en: The map parts into eighteen prints hung like a gallery wall. They turn over in a slow diagonal from the top left to your photographs (one per trip, newest first), hold as an even wall, turn back in the same order, close up, and the sheet folds into the globe. Nothing random, nothing flying.
desc.zh: 地圖分成十八張，像畫廊牆上掛的照片。從左上角開始斜斜地一張接一張翻過來，變成你的照片（每趟旅程一張，最新的在前），整齊地停成一面牆；再照同樣順序翻回地圖，合起來，折成地球。沒有亂數，沒有亂飛。

title.en: The print develops (after Odyssée and Jon McCormack)
title.zh: 顯影（來自 Odyssée 和 Jon McCormack）

desc.en: From Odyssée's few colours and Jon McCormack's stillness. The map arrives as a monochrome print, soft warm grey on paper with the routes in ink, and as it curves into the globe its colour comes up from Taiwan outward, like a print in the developing tray.
desc.zh: 來自 Odyssée 很少的顏色和 Jon McCormack 的安靜。一進來地圖是一張單色的版畫，淡淡的暖灰色印在紙上，只有路線是墨色；地圖彎成地球的時候，顏色從台灣開始往外慢慢浮出來，像照片在顯影盤裡顯影。

desc.en: The map is a grey print; its colour comes up from Taiwan as it curls into the globe, and its edges thin away onto the trip's photograph beneath, which also comes up from grey to colour.
desc.zh: 地圖是一張灰色的相片，捲成地球時顏色從台灣開始顯出來；邊緣慢慢散開，露出底下那趟旅行的照片，照片也從灰色慢慢變成彩色。

desc.en: Eighteen prints turn over one after another to your photographs, grey at first, their colour coming up while they hang; they turn back to a grey map, whose colour comes up from Taiwan as it folds into the globe.
desc.zh: 十八張照片一張接一張翻過來，先是灰的，掛著的時候慢慢顯出顏色；再翻回灰色的地圖，折成地球時顏色從台灣開始顯出來。

title.zh: 畫廊＋掀開：十八張拼成一張照片

desc.en: The eighteen prints turn over to one photograph between them, the trip's; they turn back to the map, and the globe folds over that same photograph, which then fills the page for the reading.
desc.zh: 十八張一張接一張翻過來，合起來是同一張照片，就是這趟旅行的照片；再翻回地圖，折成地球時，底下就是剛剛那張照片，接著鋪滿整頁讓你讀這趟旅行。

title.en: Painted paper globe, closing in strips
title.zh: 手繪紙地球，一條一條包起來

desc.en: New, from your references: a globe printed on paper and tinted in watercolour, after Bellerby & Co, the oceans named in engraved capitals. On arrival the routes are drawn in ink from Taiwan and each country takes its wash as its line lands; scrolling cuts the map into twelve strips that close round Taiwan one by one, as a globemaker pastes them on.
desc.zh: 新的，照你選的參考做：像 Bellerby & Co 那樣印在紙上、用水彩上色的地球，海洋名稱像雕版印的字。一打開，航線從台灣用墨水一條條畫出去，線到了哪個國家，那裡就染上顏色；往下捲，地圖切成十二條，從台灣那一條開始，一條一條貼到球上。

desc.en: Version 4 with your photographs in the transition: the map was printed over the trip's photograph, so the cuts open onto it, and it is there, whole, behind the globe once it closes. It is the same photograph the reading then shows.
desc.zh: 第四版加上你的照片：地圖像是印在這趟旅行的照片上面，切開的縫裡看得到照片，地球合起來以後，整張照片就在地球後面。和往下讀時背景那張是同一張。

desc.en: Version 4 with your photographs in the transition: a small print from every trip lies under the map; the strips lift off them, and the globe closes in the middle of the prints.
desc.zh: 第四版加上你的照片：地圖下面放著每趟旅行一張的小照片，紙條掀起來就看到它們，地球在這圈照片中間合起來。

desc.en: Version 4 with your photographs in the transition: each strip has one of your photographs printed down its back, seen as the strips swing round to close the far side.
desc.zh: 第四版加上你的照片：每一條紙的背面印著你的一張照片，紙條翻過去包住地球背面時看得到。

title.en: Prints wall, photographs on the backs

desc.en: The live page with your photographs: every print is two-sided, the map on its face and one of your photographs on its back, in a thin paper border. You see them as the prints turn over on their way round the ball; the flat map and the finished globe stay map.
desc.zh: 正式版加上你的照片：每張相片兩面都有，正面是地圖，背面是你的一張照片，外面一圈細細的紙邊。相片翻過去飛到地球另一邊時看得到；平面地圖和合起來的地球還是地圖。

title.en: Prints wall, the edges are photographs

desc.en: The live page with your photographs: the prints along the wall's faded top and bottom are your photographs. They come up out of the paper as they lift off, and turn into map as they are laid on the ball.
desc.zh: 正式版加上你的照片：牆上下兩邊淡掉的那幾排相片是你的照片，拿起來時從紙裡浮出來，貼到地球上時變回地圖。

desc.en: Row 11, but the photo ball stays while the globe glides aside, and turns back to the map, Taiwan's first, when you start reading the first trip; scroll back above it and it is photographs again.
desc.zh: 跟第 11 版一樣，但地球移到旁邊時照片球還留著，開始讀第一趟旅程時才從台灣那幾張翻回地圖；捲回上面又變回照片。

desc.en: Row 11, but not every print turns back: about one in four stays a photograph, so the globe is a map with your prints pasted here and there.
desc.zh: 跟第 11 版一樣，但不是每張都翻回地圖：大約四張留一張照片，地球是地圖，上面到處貼著你的照片。

desc.en: The globe keeps a ring of photographs round its edge, and its front, round the trip you are reading, turns back to the map; the window moves with each trip.
desc.zh: 地球四周留一圈照片，正面你在讀的那趟旅程附近翻回地圖；換一趟旅程，窗就跟著移過去。

desc.en: New: one paper globe you zoom freely, from the whole world down to a city, holding every place you have been and every trip. City dots grow with each visit, the countries deepen with each return, and close up your photographs lie at their places as small prints. An index of places and trips beside it; any trip can be played.
desc.zh: 新的：一顆紙地球，可以自由拉近拉遠，從整個世界一路到一座城市，記著你去過的每個地方、走過的每趟旅程。城市的點去越多次越大，國家每回去一次顏色就深一點，拉近時你的照片像小相片一樣放在拍的地方。旁邊是地方和旅程的目錄；每一趟都可以播放。

desc.en: The same personal atlas, now lit by a low warm sun: the land tinted like a hand-coloured atlas, your countries raised in terracotta, a soft rim and shadow so the globe stands on the page, each trip coloured by its year, a years line you can play, and your photographs larger at every zoom.
desc.zh: 同一本個人地圖，現在有一道溫暖的低角度陽光：陸地像手工上色的地圖，你去過的國家以赤陶色微微浮起，柔和的邊光和影子讓地球立在頁面上，每趟旅程依年份上色，還有一條可以播放的年份線，你的照片在每個縮放層級都更大。

desc.en: A hand-painted paper globe with a soft varnish: warm washed seas that deepen toward the coasts, your countries in layered clay watercolour, ocean names in both languages. It rises from a faint shadow on the page like a globe set down on a desk, then turns Taiwan to the front.
desc.zh: 一顆手繪上漆的紙地球：溫暖的海色越靠近海岸越深，你去過的國家以一層層赤陶水彩上色，海洋名稱有中英兩種文字。開場時它像放在書桌上一樣，從頁面上淡淡的影子裡升起，再把台灣轉到正面。

desc.en: An engraved paper globe in ink only: hairline coasts, waterlines along every shore, mountains drawn in short strokes, your countries hatched in clay. On arrival the coasts draw themselves outward from Taipei, then the land and your countries fill in.
desc.zh: 一顆只用墨線的銅版紙地球：細細的海岸線，沿岸的水紋線，山以短短的筆觸刻出，你去過的國家以赤陶色斜線標出。開場時海岸線從台北向外一筆一筆畫出來，接著陸地和你的國家才填上。

desc.en: An unglazed porcelain globe with no colour: the mountains are real light and shadow, the sea a smooth lower surface, and your countries glazed in clay so they catch the light as it turns. It arrives as a flat tile that turns upright and swells into a sphere.
desc.zh: 一顆沒有上色的素燒瓷地球：山是真實的光與影，海是較低較平滑的表面，你去過的國家上了一層赤陶釉，轉動時會映出光。開場時它是一片平放的瓷片，立起來後慢慢鼓成一顆球。

desc.en: A paper globe drawn in fine olive form lines, with ink coasts and quiet clay for your countries; closer in, finer lines appear. It opens close over Taiwan and rises steadily to the whole world, your trips drawing out as each country comes into view.
desc.zh: 一顆用細細橄欖色地形線畫成的紙地球，墨色海岸，你的國家淡淡的赤陶色；拉近時會出現更細的線。開場時從台灣上空近處開始，平穩地升高到整個世界，每看到一個國家，你的旅程就畫出來。

desc.en: A quiet paper globe with your photographs laid where you took them, as small bordered prints. On arrival they start as a loose contact sheet and each one flies home to its place, Taiwan first, while the globe appears beneath them.
desc.zh: 一顆安靜的紙地球，你的照片像有白邊的小相片一樣放在拍攝的地方。開場時它們先像一張攤開的印樣，接著每一張飛回自己的地方，台灣的最先，地球也在它們下面慢慢出現。

question.en: 1 is the live page. 2 to 4 keep its opening and fold, then turn your trips into one camera move your scroll conducts: the whole globe turning, the camera close over each trip, or the globe's curve as a horizon under your photograph. Scroll slowly past the fold and through a few trips, then score each and mark what to change.
question.zh: 第 1 張是正式版。第 2 到 4 張開頭和捲成地球都一樣，之後把你的旅程變成一段由捲動帶著走的鏡頭：整顆地球跟著轉、鏡頭貼近每一趟、或地球的弧線變成你照片下的地平線。慢慢捲過地球、再捲過幾趟旅程，每張給分，哪裡要改就標出來。
